fusions.name: Dislodge
fusions.desc: Hurls your whole weight at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 16 damage, up to twice that at full reach, and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Quarry Fall
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Counter-Butt
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Rolling Scree
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
